training: historical source age >= 24 h; targets use only reactions strictly before replay start
capacity_formula: fraction * historical threads / sum(history event source span + 24 hours)
scoring: latest available 1/6/24 h prefix model on the log-remaining-growth score scale
baseline: current visible reaction count; FIFO by source arrival
reward: all recorded reactions strictly after actual review; common denominator reactions after age 1 h

service.slots: start + j / capacity for j = 0, ..., floor((end - start) * capacity)
service.same_time_order: determine eligibility and newest available snapshot at slot; reactions at slot count as observed
service.stop: last grid slot no later than end; no early stop for an empty queue
